weapon.d: Effective against flying foes. Grants Spd+3. If a bonus granted by a skill like Rally or Hone and/or 1 extra space of movement granted by a skill like Armor March or Armored Boots is active, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+3 and Special cooldown charge +1 per unit's attack during combat. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

a.d: If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces; max 3).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces + 2; max 5).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd+X to unit during combat (X = 2 × number of allies within 2 spaces, + 1; max 7).

b.d: If unit initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat. If unit's HP ≤ 40% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.

If unit initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat. If unit's HP ≤ 60% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.

If unit initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat. If unit's HP ≤ 80% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.

c.d: At start of turn, grants Spd+2 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, grants Spd+3 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, grants Spd+4 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Spd+5 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn.

builds.name: Brazen Duo
builds.desc:
The idea of this build is very simple: get under 80% HP, activate double Brazen and destroy everything with Fire Emblem.
Instead of Joint Hone skills, skills like Armor March would work as well. (Basically anything to get the necessary +1 special cooldown works.)
